question: Mirzai and bandi (types of jackets in white or black) are popular in the _____ region.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bundelkhand and Malwa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirzai and bandi (types of jackets in white or black) are popular in the Bundelkhand and Malwa region**__.

 __
 
• The color of the costumes shows the dignity and radiant appearance.
 
• Dhotis and Safas are other traditional clothes worn by the people of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Women in Madhya Pradesh wear the common dress called Lehenga and Choli.
 
 
• They also wear the Lugra or Orni which is covered over the shoulder and head.
 
• The costumes are generally in Black and Red colors and some women also wear the dress in Black and Red colors.
